tools.name: search_spec
tools.title: Search the spec
tools.description: Search The Website Specification for matching topics. Returns ranked results with title, status, category, canonical URL, and a one-line summary. Use this when the user asks about a topic by keyword (e.g. "CSP", "alt text", "llms.txt").

tools.name: list_topics
tools.title: List spec topics
tools.description: List spec topics, optionally filtered by category and/or status. Returns title, status, category, summary, and URL per topic. Use this when the user wants the canonical list (e.g. "all required SEO topics"). Results are paged — follow page/page_size to walk the whole list.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.title: Read a spec topic
tools.description: Fetch the Markdown for one spec page by its slug, returned as lines you can page through. Use this after search_spec or list_topics to read the canonical guidance.

slug.description: Kebab-case slug, as listed by list_topics or search_spec. Examples: 'content-security-policy', 'meta-robots', 'llms-txt'.

tools.name: open_search
tools.title: Open site search
tools.description: Open the on-page ⌘K search overlay so the user can search the spec interactively. Optionally pre-fills a query. UI action — does not return results; use search_spec for that.

tools.name: open_checklist
tools.title: Open the checklist
tools.description: Navigate the user to the full spec checklist page. Optionally jumps to a category section via URL hash. UI action — does not return data.
